subdomain: 4.6 Monitor system performance using logging and observability tools

en.question: For the same completed request, Messages API usage reports input_tokens=1200, cache_creation_input_tokens=2000, and cache_read_input_tokens=6800. Its OpenTelemetry span reports gen_ai.usage.input_tokens=10000, with cache-read and cache-write details also available. What total input should each interface independently report after normalization?

options.note: Messages API input_tokens is the uncached portion, so using 1200 alone omits 2000 cache-write and 6800 cache-read tokens. The OpenTelemetry total of 10000 is already inclusive.
Summing the Messages API categories correctly gives 10000. Adding cache-read and cache-write details to gen_ai.usage.input_tokens incorrectly counts those 8800 tokens twice.

Messages API total input is 1200 + 2000 + 6800 = 10000, whereas the OpenTelemetry input total already includes cache activity. These are alternative observations of one request and should not be added together.
Adding the normalized API total to the telemetry total duplicates the same request's usage. Independent interfaces are not separate input-processing events.

references.title: Anthropic: OpenTelemetry tracing for the Claude API
